name: guildcontrol
description: Safety-first MCP server for Discord with privacy-safe reads, audits, and reviewed administration
long_description: Use an operator-owned Discord application and bot through one strict non-secret policy file. Read operations stay exactly scoped, high-impact changes require fresh reviewed plans and signed confirmation, and durable records exclude Discord content and display data.

config_file.title: GuildControl MCP configuration
config_file.description: Select one strict versioned non-secret GuildControl MCP JSON configuration file.

bot_token.title: Discord bot token
bot_token.description: Token for your own Discord bot. Never use a user token or place this value in the configuration file.
